create_dataset_get_calibration_data: create a calibration dataset from a tokenizer for quantization with specified sequence length and sample count
build_quantization_recipe_autoround: build an AutoRound quantization recipe targeting Linear layers with NVFP4 scheme and iteration count
run_oneshot_quantization: run one-shot AutoRound quantization on a model using a calibration dataset and quantization recipe
test_model_generation_after_quantization: test the quantized model by generating text from a prompt after dispatching for inference
save_quantized_model_compressed: save the quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
